dataset_name: TTS Overlap Mixtures (macOS say, test split)
pareto_optimal_system: Baseline A (Mixture-only) | Baseline B (Always-Separate) | Baseline C (Threshold theta=0.5) | Proposed (Benefit-Aware)
summary_analysis: 4 strategies evaluated on 3 sample(s). Lowest measured SA-WER: Proposed (Benefit-Aware) (89.2%). With n=3, no difference should be read as significant. Non-dominated on (SA-WER, median latency): Baseline A (Mixture-only), Baseline B (Always-Separate), Baseline C (Threshold theta=0.5), Proposed (Benefit-Aware).
warnings: Only 3 sample(s) were evaluated: differences are not statistically meaningful, and P90/P95 latency over 3 run(s) is not a meaningful percentile.

not_evaluated.Oracle (Diagnostic Bound): Requires per-region ground-truth WER deltas (baseline vs. separated), which this dataset does not provide.

definitions.standard_wer: WER of concatenated final transcript vs. concatenation of Speaker 1 and Speaker 2 references (speaker labels ignored).
definitions.speaker_attributed_wer: Sum of per-speaker word edit distances / total reference words, with hypothesis text grouped by predicted speaker label and NO speaker-permutation search. Baseline mixture output carries a single label, so this is stricter than cpWER.
definitions.overlap_wer: Proxy: Speaker 2's full reference vs. the text of hypothesis segments intersecting the planted overlap window. Reference words are not time-aligned, so this is a diagnostic, not a true region-level WER.
definitions.latency: Wall-clock of one full pipeline pass per sample (baseline ASR + overlap detection + routing + selected separation + stream ASR + reconciliation), after one discarded warm-up pass.
definitions.separation_invocation_rate: Regions routed to separation / regions detected. Undefined (None) when no region was detected.
